integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action texture emerging from expressionist ink-splash comic style, rendered in harsh high-contrast black and white, the frame laced with tearing edges and fractured, incomplete forms, in a single unbroken 15-second take inside a military command tent whose fabric walls are painted in slashing ink strokes. Zhang Liang strides violently into the tent, eyes burning like torches, and the four calligraphic characters “伐暴之名” erupt from his mouth, condensing into several razor-sharp ink blades that streak across the space and drive straight at Liu Bang's chest with a crisp, porcelain-shattering crack. On impact, the once-blazing, radiant character “仁” glowing behind Liu Bang's back instantly collapses, splintering into a storm of black-and-white debris that scatters across the entire frame as the ink-comic style dissolves into raw live-action texture. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward Liu Bang's face; his lips part slightly, his pupils lose focus staring at nothing, and above his head a frail, wavering bubble surfaces containing the single character “默”, an absurd, pitiful counterpoint to Zhang Liang's overwhelming blade-like presence still filling the left of the frame. After the shatter, all ambient sound falls into graveyard-dead silence, broken only by Liu Bang's trembling inner monologue. The pale, hollow-eyed Liu Bang (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] “‘伐暴之名’？……这句话……像一把刀，把我层层剖开。我本是要诛灭苛政，如今却也成了压人的那一方？不……不是这样……可为什么……我连一句辩解都说不出来？”</d> while his lips remain completely closed. The shot ends on his frozen, hollow face.

overall_soundscape: A crisp, porcelain-shattering crack rings out as the ink blades strike, followed abruptly by graveyard-dead silence across the tent. Only faint fabric settling and the almost inaudible tremor of Liu Bang's breathing remain beneath the voiceover.
